name: People Who Dont Like You
overview: Scripture encourages believers to find refuge and strength in God, especially when facing opposition from those who may not like them. Dwelling in the secret place of the Most High offers divine protection and favor both from God and man, as promised in Psalms 91:1 and Proverbs 3:4. Believers are called to trust and wait upon the Lord, who renews their strength and provides help in times of fear and discouragement, as seen in Isaiah 40:31 and 41:10. Moreover, by following Christ’s teaching to treat others as we wish to be treated, we reflect God’s righteousness even amid conflict (Matthew 7:12). In all circumstances, calling on God leads to revelation and support beyond human understanding (Jeremiah 33:3).
